hebrewText: מֵ/עָנִ֞י הֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֗/וֹ נֶ֤שֶׁךְ וְ/תַרְבִּית֙ לֹ֣א לָקָ֔ח מִשְׁפָּטַ֣/י עָשָׂ֔ה בְּ/חֻקּוֹתַ֖/י הָלָ֑ךְ ה֗וּא לֹ֥א יָמ֛וּת בַּ/עֲוֺ֥ן אָבִ֖י/ו חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶֽה

tokens.bdb: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again

tokens.bdb: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
